fields.issue: The conservative high-pressure humid day becomes supersaturated in the all-weather 500m-floor diagnostic. The 0/10/100m-floor main cases are unsaturated in the stated model. Continuing an unsaturated lapse through cloud is not a physical forecast.
fields.next_evidence: Use a moist atmospheric profile with cloud/condensate treatment; do not treat that diagnostic height as an operational guarantee.
